items.title: J. Leo Rayhill interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 23, 2007
items.q: He used to call me all the time with requests and stuff, he was a wonderful man.

ctx.x: Yes, he was very proud of that.
Very, very good. He used to call me all the time with requests and stuff, he was a wonderful man. His daughter I’ve talked to a couple of times, she’s very nice.
